response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS src, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS r, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS n FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) AS a FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_ratio, SUM(g.n) AS total_projects, AVG(g.n - t.a) AS avg_excess FROM g, t WHERE g.n > t.a;

assumptions.assumption: Ratio is computed per spatial row as boxy/boxz; rows with NULL boxy or boxz, or boxz = 0 (division yields NULL), are ignored. Each funding source's ratio is the mean over its rows, and the final ratio is the unweighted mean of the kept sources' ratios.
Only projects with at least one matching spatial record (inner join) count toward distinct projects and toward the cross-source average. NULL fundflux forms its own group.
The cross-source average is the unweighted mean of per-source distinct project counts, and 'kept' means strictly above it.
